Hi Team, 

Warranty maintenance jobs are created from maintenance plans. These are created by the automated process and never done manually, 
These jobs always have the no invoice ticked automatically when the work order is generated. 
From the first of Feb we have notice a few jobs that have been generated with the no invoice as false. 
I did attempt replicating the issue in partial but worked as expected, it seems like an intermittent issue and have not been able to capture a log. 
My understanding is that the checkbox is being set to true based on the work type of the work order. 

Below is the query being used to Monitor the issue :

SELECT Id,  WorkOrderNumber, SAP_Message_Text_IO__c, MaintenancePlan.MaintenancePlanNumber,  hm_No_Invoice__c, format(CreatedDate), MaintenancePlan.DoesAutoGenerateWorkOrders FROM WorkOrder where hm_No_Invoice__c=false and  WorkType.name like'%Warranty Maintenance'  order by CreatedDate desc

Impact: 
Customers have received invoices for work they are not meant to be charged for. 

Work order created in partial (This worked as per expectation ) 
https://hussmann-nz--partial.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/WorkOrder/0WOA8000003bzkLOAQ/view
